positive.sql: SELECT DISTINCT person_id FROM person_visits WHERE (visit_date >= '2022-01-06' AND visit_date <= '2022-01-09') OR pizzeria_id = 2 ORDER BY person_id DESC;
SELECT person_id FROM person_visits WHERE visit_date BETWEEN '2022-01-06' AND '2022-01-09' OR pizzeria_id = 2 GROUP BY person_id ORDER BY person_id DESC;
